note: Known deficit for tools/release/check_production_stream_defaults.py: 27 sites across 8 production files. The pin records every production declaration matching cudaStream_t <name> = nullptr and is a ratchet, not a detector: any difference fails, so growth is a regression and shrinkage requires a deliberate recorded update. Tests are excluded because a defaulted stream in a test does not race the product's non-blocking compute streams. Most pinned sites represent the unordered-default-stream hazard; two lifecycle sentinels are intentionally included because the ratchet counts the pattern consistently. CudaStream::stream_ has no setter and its constructor either creates a non-blocking stream or throws. UploadSlots::Impl::Slot::transfer and consumer are guarded retirement and activation markers assigned only on the live upload path. Editing this file is the record of the decision; do not silently re-baseline it.
